baseline.workingTree: Existing staged/unstaged work retained. This batch changes audit reports and summary only.

declaredStatus.claim: The unreleased product uses current packages and generation/native installation formats, without previous source-JSON installation or compatibility entries. Current plugin upgrade/rollback/crash recovery remain supported.
declaredStatus.limits: This is a scoped entry/ownership review, not whole-runtime or whole-project acceptance.

checks.detail: 21 root/app/package manifests and both production closures have no old @any-music/music-sources package, plugin-center/declarative export or production CLI/testkit dependency. Eighteen composition files and 669 imports across selected entries/tests have no targeted former source installer/import identifier.

Canonical registration and exact permission checks pass; 61 command names are unique and no targeted old source-install/archive alias occurs. Current .amplugin install and manual rollback are retained. Distinct legitimate operations such as load/save, preview/install and cancel/release are not collapsed.

198 owned inventory files include 128 TypeScript/test sources in their current source/app/SDK owners. No selected app test retains the old source protocol test stems or old package imports. Generated Rust serde/field checks match the SDK source (47 definitions). Existing dependency/lightweight/public export checks pass.

All selected source/test/fixture/generated files retain their baseline hashes; no production file is deleted or rewritten. Current .amplugin archive validation, native preview/consent/manual rollback and crash-recovery ownership are preserved. Fixture identifiers such as legacy:leaf are not classified as previous-schema readers.

All nine previously edited guidance files, the two supporting native-renderer storage/account contracts, and all 101 files in the counterpart/index baseline remain unchanged. Prior B20 scoped conclusions remain valid for this closure.

readScope.limits: AST/manifest/registry inventories are not a full semantic audit of all code. Entry graph evidence is static, without a new production bundle. Runtime report live evidence is not-run.

unreadPaths: Full native and GM transport/business chains

missingEvidence: No full-root test/typecheck/lint/build/native/MSRV/deny rerun for this report-only batch; existing B21 results need their own hash reconciliation.

External URLs and complete prose translation semantics remain outside the earlier structural B20 candidate.
dependencies: All earlier B20 evidence was checked for relevant file drift before closure

nextBatch.question: Reconcile the completed scoped B20 reports with the existing B21 final report and current hashes, preserving all other unreviewed/live/unsupported limits and reusing only still-valid gates.

Unrequested product fixes, app/browser/emulator work, recapture, commit or push

handoff: B20-targeted-legacy-check-repository：基线 0dde162 与输入哈希。本批完成两端独立入口和所有权检查，未发现新问题，未修改产品代码或删除文件。Userscript 只装配构建已知来源并固定 none；Tauri 从原生能力装配来源及安装/预览端口。21 份清单、18 个装配文件和 669 个导入未命中旧来源包/解释器安装入口；61 个 IPC 名称唯一，旧来源安装/归档别名未命中。当前包安装、原生确认回退和崩溃恢复保持原样。198 个测试/夹具/生成归属条目及公开依赖检查通过，SDK 生成 Rust 校验一致。17 个边界回归、Userscript 三项和 Tauri 五项，共 25 项通过。前两批九份修订文档及相关存储契约、第三批 101 份结构输入哈希均未变。B20 四个候选均完成，九项文档问题已修复；当前范围 conformant/pass-scoped。无新构建或运行验收，原 PyYAML 辅助校验缺口仍单列。下一入口为 B21-repository-final-reconciliation，仅与现有汇总和有效门禁对账，不宣称全项目验收。
